senses.gloss:
Elakākṣakathā
Jain. Pkt. from Rātribhojanakathā. Pattan I. p. 13.
See Rātribhojanakathā.

Elācārya
son of Ananta.
--C. on Śivamahimnastava of Puṣpadanta. Bomb. Uni. 1670 (i). Harshe p. 46.
--C. on Aparādhasundarastotra ascribed to Śaṅkarācārya. Bomb. Uni. 1670 (ii).

Elācārya
one of the traditional names of Kundakundācārya, considered by some a. the a. of the Tirukkural in Tamil. See Jain Ant. IV. iii. p. 75.
See Kundakundācārya.

Elācārya
Jain. teacher. C. 750 A. D. disciple of Kumāranandin of Kundakundānvaya an. preceptor of Vīrasena (a. of Dhavalā, C. on Ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama). See Jain Ant. XII. i. p.. 1-6; Proceed. AIOC. X (Tirupati, 1940), p. 215.

Ellayārya,_Kañcam
--Śrāddhalakṣaṇa. Mad. Uni. 25. See yallayArya, kaJcam
